svg.title: Orbit
svg.desc: An open ring with a single small hollow node resting in the opening. Freedom from restriction: the ring is not closed; nothing is sealed in and nothing is kept out. Private use of what is private: the node is a hollow circle, a small room of its own, not a dot on a tracker. Orbit, subtly: the node lies on the ring's path, so it reads as something circling you without an orbit line.
